task: Week 2 Task 2.5 - Advanced Model Training and Comparison

excluded_columns.timestamp: Used only to define chronological partitions; raw epoch magnitude is not a predictor.
excluded_columns.building_id: High-cardinality identity could encourage memorization and is not portable to unseen buildings.
excluded_columns.site_id: Site identity could proxy geography/collection artifacts; weather and building attributes are retained.

training_design.subset_method: evenly spaced row indices via linspace; order preserved

target_strategy.log: fit log1p(meter_reading), inverse with expm1, clip negative inverse predictions to zero only

selection.rationale: LightGBM is the best advanced validation candidate, but it does not improve Random Forest validation MAE or test RMSE; retain Random Forest for Task 2.6.
